versions.content: ⌊ DRAFT g The Os High Proxy shall contain a required ser- vice resource SwCluCOsProxyOsBaseSocket . This collects all hooks needed to be linked to the Host Software Cluster . It also contains Applicative Software Cluster local Os specific functions for StartOs, initialize and shutdown. It should also cover the local IOC , if present. It is recommended that this resource is marked with the mandatory flag ( SwCluCBManifIsMandatory ).
